test_title: PYST 72: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c70053df36b45c67a8a751b59572893fb8c732add8c724a62df8f9e761ad0117.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: AD – HB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/731b073a6e4639747c3b4a9807bc0f14a24b72537a1bee0a6870bd3348991974.png] 

Option 2: EH – LG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21907ad55b41b9509e0ddc77a66bc9c35fe6a0d021a2cf714178974b154b08db.png] 

Option 3: CF – JE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501d6376cf10c1c00de6409f64c6f0441d7b5901955b8c88a91699f22ca5525b.png] 

Option 4: GJ – NI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a18fe3c846bd470cddaaeda00ef1714732f7b8169ca0523e83f34241ba20168.png] 

Thus, AD – HB does not follow the given rule.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 1.**
